summary: W2 Alembic main §4b(C) coldStart hard gate and plan-driven dimensions/budget for alembic-mainbody-lifecycle-adaptation-2026-06-26. Consume accepted producers: AlembicCore commit 1553e2f8b7167b596b4c305f0bc40f46dd047359 (@alembic/core/plans applyPlanSelection/assertPlanSelectionShape) and AlembicAgent commit 4ab2beeb05a78619144cb0d45f663801705f8e11 (@alembic/agent/service runPlanAgent). Implement only §4b(C1-C4) in Alembic main repo. At DaemonJobRunner executeApiAiWorkflow bootstrap path, build ProjectContext facts, runPlanAgent for generationStage coldStart, applyPlanSelection, and pass executionDimensions/budget/moduleScope into coldStart. Enforce PD-5 hard gate: plan failure/timeout/provider error/invalid or empty dimensions must record job error, mark job failed, runColdStartWorkflow 0 times, no fallback-to-full wording or behavior. Preserve PD-9 explicit intent.dimensionIds precedence over plan; preserve PD-8 separation: plan.scale controls maxFiles/contentMaxLines/totalRecipeBudget but does not replace computeAnalystBudget/token quality floor. ColdStartWorkflow must use plan executionDimensions instead of all baseDimensions for coldStart while retaining baseDimensions as facts seed pool. No AlembicCore/AlembicAgent/AlembicPlugin edits, no schema changes, no guard relaxation. Validate Node>=22 build:check and focused tests for PD-5 failure, legal narrow selection length>=1, empty length abort, plan-driven dimension count not full set, explicit dimension precedence, scale budget pass-through with computeAnalystBudget still called, logs without fallback-to-full. Commit on Alembic main and return commit hash, changed files, validation output, raw evidence, residual risks.
